16. A cavity determination apparatus for determining a cavity within an object, the apparatus comprising:
- an introduction element for being introduced into the cavity, wherein the introduction element comprises a bendable segment for being arranged within the cavity in different arrangements;
- a curve determination device processor configured to determine a set of curves defined by the bendable segment, wherein each curve is defined by an introduction of the bendable segment within the cavity in a respective arrangement of the different arrangements and the determined set of curves comprises contact curves and non-contact curves, the contact curves and non-contact curves not being distinguished from eash other by contact information; and
- a cavity reconstruction device processor configured to reconstruct the cavity in response to the determined set of curves.
17. The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the cavity reconstruction device processor reconstructs the cavity using a regularization in response to the set of the determined curves and a morphological opening or closing of the set of the determined curves to estimate which points of the set of the determined curves lie necessarily within the cavity.
18. The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the cavity reconstruction processor is further configured to determine whether one or more determined curves of the set of determined curves is a contact curve and reconstruct the cavity in response to the determined one or more contact curves.
19. The apparatus of claim 16 further comprising a display device, operatively coupled to the cavity reconstruction device processor, configured to display a representation of the reconstructed cavity.
20. The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the cavity reconstruction device processor is adapted to provide an adaptable cavity model and to adapt the cavity model to the determined curves defined by the bendable segment in the different arrangements for reconstructing the cavity.
21. The apparatus of claim 20, wherein the cavity model is adapted to wrap determined curves that are not contact curves.
22. The apparatus of claim 20, wherein the adaptable cavity model is an anatomical model.
23. The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the curve determination device processor is configured to determine the curves defined by the bendable segment within the cavity by optical shape sensing.
24. A cavity determination method for determining a cavity within an object, the method comprising: - determining non-contact curves defined by a bendable segment of an introduction element introduced into the cavity in different arrangements within the cavity by a curve determination unit, and - reconstructing the cavity from the determined curves by a cavity reconstruction unit.
25. The method of claim 24, comprising adapting a cavity model to the determined curves defined by the bendable segment in the different arrangements for reconstructing the cavity
26. A cavity determination computer program for determining a cavity within an object, wherein the computer program is characterized by non-transitory program code means for causing a cavity determination apparatus as defined in claim 16 to carry out following steps, when the computer program is run on a computer provided with one or more processors for controlling the cavity determination apparatus:
determining, using the curve determination processor, a set of curves, each curve being defined by the bendable segment of the introduction element introduced into the cavity in the respective arrangement of different arrangements within the cavity, the determined set of curves comprising contact curves and non-contact curves, the contact curves and non-contact curves not being distinguished from eash other by contact information;
reconstructing using the cavity reconstruction processor, the cavity from the determined curves; and
displaying, on a display device operatively coupled to the cavity construction processor, a representation of the reconstructed cavity.
